jobs.title: Senior Art Director
jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Art Director, you'll lead the visual development of high-impact creative concepts and scalable key visual systems that anchor brand and social presence across the MEA region, flexing seamlessly across in-store activations, experiential touchpoints, print, OOH, and digital/social platforms while leveraging advanced generative AI workflows to accelerate concepting and production. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Lead the visual direction and craft for integrated campaigns spanning experiential events, retail/POS activations, print, out-of-home, and digital touchpoints.
* Partner closely with copywriters to concept big, cohesive campaign ideas from scratch that translate across both physical and digital ecosystems.
* Develop extensible campaign Key Visuals (KVs) that serve as the foundational visual identity for full social content systems, graphic design rollouts, and multi-channel adaptations.
* Champion and embed generative AI tools (such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway) into creative pipelines to rapidly visualize concepts, explore visual directions, and streamline asset adaptation.
* Direct photoshoots, CGI pipelines, and retouching processes, creating precise briefs for photographers, stylists, model talent, and post-production specialists.
* Oversee production quality and execution integrity by collaborating with vendors and production partners on material selection, print specifications, and on-site builds.
* Present creative concepts, KVs, and craft rationales to senior client stakeholders with strategic clarity and conviction.
* Partner cross-functionally with strategists, designers, and producers to safeguard visual consistency and brand guidelines throughout the campaign lifecycle.

### **About You**

### **The essentials:**

* Full professional fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is essential, with the proven ability to concept, craft, and art direct in both languages.
* 8+ years of creative agency experience with a demonstrated track record leading BTL campaigns, large-scale experiential activations, and social-first creative work.
* Strong, award-caliber portfolio exhibiting conceptual depth, craft excellence, and scalable visual systems across diverse formats.
* Hands-on proficiency using generative AI tools (e.g., Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, ChatGPT) within modern creative and production workflows.
* Deep cultural intelligence and strong command of consumer nuances across Dubai and the wider MEA region.
* Exceptional presentation, client leadership, and storytelling capabilities.
* Collaborative, solutions-oriented leadership style with uncompromising standards for creative quality.

### **Not a must, but a plus:**

* Experience art directing motion design, 3D/CGI, or immersive interactive experiences.
* Prior experience working within global creative network agency environments.
* Relevant degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or Advertising.

  

**#LI-FP1**

**About Monks**

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek's first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show's inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: Personal Content Creator & AI Video Specialist
jobs.description:
WE’RE HIRING: PERSONAL CONTENT CREATOR & AI VIDEO SPECIALIST

Dubai, UAE | Full-time

I’m a luxury real estate broker specializing in high-end villas on Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. I’m looking for a creative, ambitious Content Creator to work directly with me and help build my personal brand.

Responsibilities:

\* Film and edit high-quality Instagram Reels and short-form videos.

\* Accompany me to luxury properties, viewings, and locations across Dubai.

\* Develop creative ideas, scripts, captions, and storytelling.

\* Use AI tools to create innovative video effects, visuals, and engaging content.

\* Help grow my Instagram audience and generate qualified real estate leads.

Requirements:

\* Strong filming and video editing skills.

\* Experience with Instagram Reels and AI content creation tools.

\* Creative mindset and ability to generate ideas independently.

\* Good written English.

\* Experience in luxury real estate or personal branding is a plus.

Salary & Benefits:

\* AED 8,000–12,000/month, depending on experience.

\* Performance bonuses for successful content and qualified leads.

\* Additional bonuses for deals generated through social media.

\* Medical insurance and opportunities for salary growth.

Most importantly, I’m looking for someone who brings fresh ideas, takes initiative, and understands how to turn content into real business results.

To apply: Send your CV, portfolio, examples of AI-generated content, and Instagram profile via DM or email.

Pay: AED8,000.00 - AED12,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai

jobs.title: AI Video Production Team (4 Roles Open)
jobs.description:
We are scaling our media pipeline and hiring a powerhouse team of 4 AI Video Specialists to produce high-end, cinematic AI video content. We are looking for creators who understand that AI tools generate the frames, but human artistry makes the film.

Positions: AI Video Directors / Editors (3 Openings)

Looking for technical creatives who can act as a "Director in the prompt box" and polished post-production editors.  
What you need:

* Cinematic AI Prompting: Ability to control generative engines like a real director. Your text/image-to-video prompts must explicitly control camera movements (e.g., orbits, pans, tilts), lighting setups (e.g., volumetric, high-contrast, cinematic styles), and audio/mood dynamics.
* Character & Scene Consistency: Mastery of maintaining asset continuity across multiple generations and tools (e.g., Runway, Sora, Midjourney, Kling, or specialized pipelines).
* Traditional Post-Production: Advanced editing skills using industry software (such as Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects).
* Pacing & Sound Design: Ability to clean up AI outputs, fix continuity flaws, build seamless shot transitions, and layer high-quality sound effects/music.

General Requirements:

* A portfolio or showreel showcasing actual AI-generated video work is mandatory.
* Deep understanding of structural prompting frameworks to keep generation iterations cost-effective.
* Already located in the UAE.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Mandatory):

* Scriptwriting experience
* Proficiency in the Arabic language

jobs.title: Graphic Designer & AI Video Creator
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a creative and innovative Graphic Designer & AI Video Creator to develop high-quality visual content for digital marketing, social media, branding, and promotional campaigns. The ideal candidate should have strong graphic design skills and practical experience using AI-powered tools to create engaging videos, animations, and marketing visuals.

Key Responsibilities

* Design creative graphics, social media posts, advertisements, brochures, flyers, and marketing materials.
* Create professional promotional videos, reels, and short-form content using AI video-generation tools.
* Develop AI-generated videos, animations, and visual concepts for marketing campaigns.
* Create and edit video content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms.
* Develop visual concepts in line with the company's brand identity and guidelines.
* Use AI tools to generate images, videos, voiceovers, and creative marketing content.
* Edit videos, add transitions, subtitles, sound effects, and background music.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative campaigns and content ideas.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Proven experience in graphic design and video creation.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro or equivalent software.
* Experience with AI tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Kling AI, Pika, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of AI video generation, image generation, and video editing techniques.
* Strong understanding of social media content formats and digital marketing requirements.
* Creative thinking, attention to detail, and good time-management skills.
* A portfolio demonstrating graphic design work and AI-generated videos.
* Stay updated with the latest graphic design trends, AI technologies, and video creation tools.

Pay: AED1,700.00 - AED2,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Creative Technologist, AV Experience Required
jobs.description:
Long Description:

**WHO WE ARE**

  

AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.

Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As part of XTG (Experience Technology Group), Technologists provide creative AV designs to enable experiential storytelling. This customer-facing, senior design role supports business development, leads pre-sales creative engineering and provides on-going post-sales project support. The Technologist should be skilled in technology consulting for both internal sales and customers, providing leadership in planning and budgeting. Responsibilities include creating system descriptions, block flow diagrams, estimating hours, highlighting logistical challenges for pricing, and preparing equipment lists for customer proposals.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide creative technology and AV design leadership for XTG and their partners supporting the Dubai office.
* Partner with XTG Business Development Team to build relationships within the experiential design community internationally
* Work with the XTG Director of Strategic Partnerships to track new contacts and nurture existing partner relationships
* Translate customer requirements into creative visioning presentations and functional system designs
* Communicate design intent with hand sketches, electronic drawings, renderings, diagrams, outlines, storyboards, and/or narratives
* Contribute to the development of engineering and architectural (RCP/Floor Plan) drawings, calculations and facilitate coordination with disciplines and trades
* Review pre-construction design and documentation
* Assist with technical design pricing and identify any logistical challenges
* Generate functional system descriptions and block diagrams
* Provide engineering support to project installation team when needed
* Serve as Customer liaison for engineering inquiries
* Meet with vendors/prospective vendors to help evaluate products and identify new creative technologies
* Post sales project consultation
* Review and validate the work of Design Engineers
* Travel to various job sites is required
* Support of meetings outside of local time zones is required (up to 20 times per year)
* Other duties assigned as needed

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

  

**Must Haves:**

* Excellent customer-facing and communications skills
* Communicate and interact with internal employees, clients and colleagues in a professional and timely manner
* Track record of designing and implementing experiential AV solutions
* Ability to work and think creatively as well as independently and ensuring to meet deadlines and solving problems with a 'how can it be done' attitude
* Ability to diagnose complex system problems
* Support user acceptance testing
* Advanced computer skills as required for the design configuration and operation of AV equipment
* Ability to travel nationally and internationally is required
* Previous work with consultancy, creative agency, production house or creative fabricator
* At least 10 years of AV experience
* Valid Driver's License and a Motor Vehicle Record that meets AVI-SPL driving standards
* Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent
* Able to attend daily meetings and participate in project activities scheduled in Gulf Standard Time (GST) and attend weekly office meetings in Dubai.

**Nice-to-Haves:**

* Formal education in Electronics or related field preferred
* AVIXA CTS-D
* A four-year degree or military experience may be considered in place of job experience. Formal education in Electronics or a related field is preferred.
* Experienced with Google Sketchup Pro or comparable design software

**WHY YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE**

  

* Medical benefits, including dental
* Paid holidays, sick days, and personal days
* Enjoyable and dynamic company culture
* Training and professional development opportunities

**MORE ABOUT US**

AVI-SPL is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability status, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law. AVI-SPL is an AA/Disabled/Veteran Protected Employer VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

AVI-SPL reserves the right to alter work hours and work location as necessary. Work hours may vary based on client requirements and may include travel to various locations in support of the account.

jobs.title: Creative Lead – Landscape Architecture
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

AtkinsRéalis is seeking an exceptional and internationally recognized Creative Lead to lead design excellence across the Middle East landscape architecture practice.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead creative direction and design vision for landmark projects across the GCC.
* Drive design excellence and innovation.
* Lead client presentations and design workshops.
* Mentor and develop landscape architects and designers.
* Support business development and major pursuits.

**About you**
-------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Landscape Architecture.
* Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior design leadership position.
* Experience delivering major public realm, hospitality, mixed-use, cultural and destination
* projects.

**International Studio Experience**

* Candidates should have experience with internationally recognized landscape architecture practices such as Gillespies, SWA Group, EDSA, Sasaki, OLIN, Grant Associates, West 8, Gustafson Porter + Bowman, or equivalent design-led firms.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Outstanding conceptual design capability.
* Strong portfolio of built and high-profile projects.
* Expertise in landscape architecture, placemaking and urban design.
* Strong understanding of GCC and Middle East context.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Rhino, AutoCAD, Revit and visualization
* tools.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
